title: Orchem MES Renewal
role: Sole publishing owner; led shared component structure and screen architecture
introduction: An MES redesign built with Vue 3 and Vite. I handled screen publishing and shared components, including AG Grid tables and tablet layouts.
myWorks: Published and structured MES work screens to fit the Vue Router / Pinia / Axios / Vue I18n setup
Used and improved shared components (AppGrid, AppInput, AppSelect, AppButton, AppAccordion, AppModalHost) for cross-screen consistency
Improved layouts and interactions for material prep, intermediate inspection, inspection results, and tablet screens
Organized AG Grid behavior—search, selection, deletion, chip rendering, conditional styling, Excel export, and row/header heights
Refined responsive and touch UI for buttons, cards, accordions, and grids on tablets
Tidied props, state, and event handling so API responses and i18n keys bind reliably
achievements: Moved repeated input, button, and modal UI into AppInput, AppSelect, AppButton, and AppModalHost
Unified AG Grid search, selection, deletion, chips, conditional styling, and export behavior behind AppGrid
Connected API responses and i18n keys through shared props, state, and event flows instead of screen-level patches
points: AG Grid search, selection, and download UI
Application screens with Vue 3 and Vite
